name: storm-control-policy
help: Configure FortiSwitch storm control policy to be applied on managed-switch ports.

description.name: description
description.help: Description of the storm control policy.

options.name: global
options.help: Apply Global or switch level storm control configuration.

options.name: override
options.help: Override global and switch level storm control to use port level configuration.

options.name: disabled
options.help: Disable storm control on the port entirely overriding global and switch level storm control.

rate.name: rate
rate.help: Threshold rate in packets per second at which storm traffic is controlled in override mode (default=500, 0 to drop all).

unknown-unicast.name: unknown-unicast
unknown-unicast.help: Enable/disable storm control to drop/allow unknown unicast traffic in override mode.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable storm control for unknown unicast traffic to drop packets which exceed configured rate limits.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable storm control for unknown unicast traffic to allow all packets.

unknown-multicast.name: unknown-multicast
unknown-multicast.help: Enable/disable storm control to drop/allow unknown multicast traffic in override mode.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable storm control for unknown multicast traffic to drop packets which exceed configured rate limits.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable storm control for unknown multicast traffic to allow all packets.

broadcast.name: broadcast
broadcast.help: Enable/disable storm control to drop/allow broadcast traffic in override mode.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable storm control for broadcast traffic to drop packets which exceed configured rate limits.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable storm control for broadcast traffic to allow all packets.
